# go version go1.26.5 darwin/arm64; a six-entry map[int]string, two range
# statements per process, printed as 'range <n>: <keys>'.

$ for i in $(seq 1 20); do ./seed.test -test.run "^TestOrder$" -test.v; done | grep "range 0" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn

   6 range 0: [1 2 3 4 5 6]
   4 range 0: [5 6 1 2 3 4]
   2 range 0: [3 4 5 6 1 2]
   1 range 0: [6 1 2 3 4 5]
   1 range 0: [2 3 4 5 6 1]
